scope: Current frozen implementation, dimensions verified from all 40 labelled cases; no model changes
range_note: Independent axis extrema do not imply an existing extreme-combination volume
prior_scope: one triple per entire 128^3 input patch
generation_scope: full-volume graph depth; patch-volume-dominant branch; not re-rooted within each patch
structure_scope: branch count and foreground voxel volume within the current patch
location_scope: patch center relative to full CT Z thirds and X halves; not coronary anatomy regions
